narrative: Material PL1__M2E62499 exhibits a moderate demand regime (CV=0.53) with an upward trend over the observation window. Mean daily demand is 1558.43 units with lead time averaging 2.60 days (CV: 0.45, volatile stability). The recommended safety stock of 3741 units (vs SAP: 655) and order quantity of 3476 units yield a 95% service level while reducing total annual costs by 26.9% ($12,862.26 savings). Lead time variability is the dominant uncertainty driver (65.8%), suggesting supplier performance focus. 3 outliers were detected and winsorised to ensure robust parameter estimation.

research_insights.selected_model: EOQ with safety stock (r,Q) — normal approximation
research_insights.selection_rationale: Standard EOQ model appropriate for moderate demand with volatile lead time variability; continuous-review (r,Q) policy is optimal given daily demand visibility and well-observed lead times.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Medium — holding costs rise significantly with the corrected safety stock, but storage capacity is not binding (policy uses 7,217 units vs. 26,980 limit). Service risk under current SAP is high.
